scope: donor-specific paper-line neutrino spectrum and source bookkeeping; no product-code edits

input_history.Fdecay: cumulative fraction of initial Be7 decayed by epoch z; not normalized on finite window
input_history.p_z_column: conditional density diagnostic only; do not use for amplitude

model.source: Khatri & Sunyaev arXiv:1009.3932v2 Eq10 literal approximation
model.branch_rounding_policy: use 0.896/0.104 throughout; do not mix section2 0.8956/0.1044
model.flavor_label: electron-flavor emitted; present spectrum all propagated flavors summed
model.mass_domain: ultrarelativistic E_obs >> m_i*c^2; no mass precision inferred

primary_export.method: raw-F piecewise-linear-in-z conservative pushforward; analytic cell moments
primary_export.bin_redshift_interval: [Eemit/Ehi-1,Eemit/Elo-1] intersect history support; E_lo=0 uses infinity
primary_export.profile_method: rate-derived dF_dz on native redshift points mapped separately for each branch

required_results: donor N0, DeltaF, early F(zmax), surviving 1-F(zmin), all normalization conventions; numerically check nH0*(YBe7/YH)=nb0*YBe7 using donor YH
branch count, present M1 and M2, mean, standard deviation, quantiles .05 .16 .50 .84 .95
branch mode of dn/dE and FWHM from rate-derived profile, interpolation method recorded
combined total present number and energy density and mean energy
computed-support and cropped [12,35]eV below/inside/above number closures
emitted neutrino/gamma and separate approximate initial recoil energy per donor and per cosmic baryon times DeltaF
absolute counts not conditional-renormalized; all emitted source versus present energy labels explicit
directLi7 omitted; no present-electron-flavor, deposited-heat, exact-Q, or mass-measurement claim

checks.independent_method: integrate rate-derived -dF_dz after Jacobian, not derivative of F interpolant
checks.failure_policy: return substantive invariant/tolerance violations to theory authority; one targeted repair, no silent renormalization

next_action_on_pass: independent Astra scientific review of donor-specific spectra and closure residuals
